name: Arcane Literacy
description: Revealed POIs additionally show their reward category. (S3)

name: Scrying Lens
description: Chart all tiles within radius 3 of any already-charted tile up to 6 hexes away. Repeated casts leapfrog the frontier.

name: Identify
description: Reveal a visible combat site's full composition before engaging. It is a scout report without stepping onto the hex, and the forces it shows are the forces you fight.

name: Ley Tap
description: While on Arcane Ground: convert 1 step into 2 Essence.
